description: This is an HTML file implementing the user interface for a database visualizer application. It contains markup, styles, and JavaScript code for managing database, table, and data display, including dynamic interactions such as fetching data from APIs, displaying tables, and expanding cell content.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of databases from the server API.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets current selections, and updates the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show or hide its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table, rendering it as an interactive table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Builds the HTML table to display fetched data, including headers and cell content.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual table cells, handling nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Handles expanding or collapsing cell content on user interaction.

search-terms: fetch API calls for database data
